# Prompt Template

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:PromptTemplate`](gmeow-PromptTemplate.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/PromptTemplate>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)

A reusable, versioned prompt with unfilled variables — the published artifact (ships the claim-extraction template as data, not code). Concrete prompts link back via [`gmeow:filledFrom`](../properties/gmeow-filledFrom.md).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:PromptTemplate`](gmeow-PromptTemplate.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Prompt`](gmeow-Prompt.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
